articles.title: More: RBA lifts cash rate to 4.85% in split 6-3 vote, sees inflation above 3% until late 2027
articles.expand: For the Australian dollar, the hike delivers little that was not already priced. Markets had assigned an 85% chance to the move, and around one and a half increases by mid-2027 were priced before the meeting. The three-member dissent and the absence of an explicit tightening bias argue against a sustained AUD rally, and leave room for a modest fade if Governor Michele Bullock’s press conference leans cautious. articles.title: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) 25bp rate hike, as widely expected
articles.expand: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85% on Tuesday, its fifth increase of 2026 and the highest level since 2008. The decision was far from unanimous, though: six board members voted to hike and three preferred to hold at 4.60%, a split that tempers the hawkish signal. The board said inflation remains elevated and broadly based, and that staff forecasts have been revised materially higher. Inflation is now expected to stay above 3% over the coming year and not to reach the top of the 2% to 3% target band until late 2027, about three quarters later than pre...
